title: Skill Execution Evaluation Suite
description: Outcome-driven skill evaluation schema aligned with agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills. Provides natural read-only user queries and expectations without hardcoding internal reference or script filenames.

prompt.description: Natural read-only user query passed verbatim to the agent.

expected_output.description: Human-readable description of the expected behavior and output.

expectations.description: Verifiable behavioral and outcome expectations. If all match -> GREEN (PASS); otherwise -> RED (FAIL, revisit skill or its components).
